audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2].text named "Liandry's/Shard" as Azir's first-item spike.
audit.why: It contradicts report[8] on the same page, which prescribes a Nashor's Tooth rush, and "Shard" is a placeholder rather than a real item name.
audit.corrected: Rewritten around Nashor's Tooth and the stack-starving that actually matters against Veigar.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns held no digit, and two claims were wrong: early said Baleful Strike "resets on kill/assist near enemies", and wants.you[1] said Shifting Sands can block skillshots.
audit.why: Baleful Strike is a 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s bolt hitting the first two enemies for 1000 range; units it kills grant permanent AP — there is no cooldown reset in the text. Azir's E shields him and dashes, it does not block anything. Real numbers that make the advice concrete: Event Horizon 20/18.5/17/15.5/14s at 725 range, Primordial Burst 120/90/60s at 650 range scaling on the target's MISSING health.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field, both Do's bodies, dontsFull[0].d, early and wants.you[1] all corrected against the kit.

audit.why: Win condition is right and worth keeping: Phenomenal Evil Power grows permanently off every spell he lands on a champion, so denying contact is the same thing as denying his scaling. The existing shove-to-starve advice already carries this.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim and dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim under unrelated titles (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED).
audit.why: The titles are about punishing his cooldown gap and about R discipline; the bodies discussed trading.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten to their titles with the real cage and R cooldowns.

edits.before: Veigar wins by landing Event Horizon (Cage), denying your pattern, and keeping the fight at a distance your kit resents.
edits.after: Veigar wins by caging you with Event Horizon, banking permanent AP off every spell that touches you, and finishing with Primordial Burst.

edits.before: - Veigar Event Horizon (Cage): matchup-defining — Only the cage EDGE stuns — hold position near the center or leave before it forms; never dash into the wall. Check it before every step-up. - E Shifting Sands is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Event Horizon: 20s at rank 1, 14s maxed — only the border stuns, so stand inside it or leave before it forms, and never dash into the wall. That 20 seconds is your step-up window. - Baleful Strike is 6s down to 4s. - Primordial Burst is 120s at rank 1 and grows on your missing health.

edits.before: Only the cage EDGE stuns — hold position near the center or leave before it forms; never dash into the wall. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: Only the border stuns — sit inside the cage or leave before it forms, and never dash into the wall. Event Horizon is 20s at rank 1; that is the window.

edits.before: W behind the wave, Q-drag the soldier through Veigar on his last-hit, auto once through the soldier, step back — two-second trades he cannot answer without overextending.
edits.after: Dark Matter lands on a delay and Event Horizon is 20s at rank 1 — the moment the cage is spent, walk up behind your sand and empty a full volley into him.

edits.before: That is Veigar’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.
edits.after: Primordial Burst scales on your missing health — never sit poked at cage range.

edits.before: Standing at max soldier range admiring your poke with E on cooldown — that is the engage window every Veigar player is waiting for.
edits.after: Emperor's Divide is 120s at rank 1 and it is the only thing that breaks a cage setup on your carry — never spend it on a wave or on poke.

edits.before: Carry through siege control — soldiers take plates, R denies engages, and your DPS curve outlasts every assassin spike in the lobby.
edits.after: Carry through range — soldiers hold the plates from outside his 725-range cage, and Emperor's Divide is the one tool that breaks his Event Horizon setup.

edits.before: If Veigar takes first blood, tighten up: Event Horizon (Cage) is now always up in your head. A second kill means the duel is over and the game isn’t — farm at soldier range and stay relevant through wave control.
edits.after: If Veigar takes first blood, tighten up: every spell he lands on you is permanent AP on Phenomenal Evil. A second kill means the duel is over and the game isn’t — farm at soldier range and control the wave.

edits.before: Your first item spike (Liandry's/Shard) gives you enough poke and clear to punish his slow, immobile farming pattern, while his stacking Phenomenal Evil Power passive is still low.
edits.after: Your first item, Nashor's Tooth, gives you the poke and clear to punish his slow, immobile farming pattern while his stacking Phenomenal Evil Power is still low — starve the stacks now.

edits.before: Use E (Shifting Sands) to escape or block skillshots the instant he flashes a cage
edits.after: Use E (Shifting Sands) to dash clear the instant he drops a cage around you

edits.before: Levels 1-2 are close to even — Veigar's Baleful Strike (Q) resets on kill/assist near enemies and both champs can farm safely from range, but the moment he lands even a partial cage combo it hurts, so treat this as a skill matchup rather than a free lane. By Level 3 your extra soldier and range start winning trades outright as long as you respect his Event Horizon threat range and don't dash into a walled area blind.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are close to even — Veigar's Baleful Strike (Q) hits the first two targets in its line and banks permanent AP off every minion it kills, and both champs farm safely from range, but the moment he lands even a partial cage combo it hurts, so treat this as a skill matchup rather than a free lane. By Level 3 your extra soldier and range start winning trades outright as long as you respect his 725-range cage and never dash blind into a walled area.

notes: phases[4..6].side were moved to Azir; win[4..6] already read "Azir" on disk and match the packet levelChart, so there is no paired content edit to propose — this closes three pre-existing cross-layer disagreements. The page's "only the cage EDGE stuns" claim is consistent with Riot's own wording ("Stuns enemies that pass through"), so I kept it and only reworded it; I did not add anything about Event Horizon's formation delay in seconds, since the kit file does not give that number.
